title: AI Citation Ready Blog Strategy
target_queries: how to make a blog citation ready for AI search

passages.heading: What makes a blog citation ready for AI search?
passages.text: A citation ready blog page gives readers a direct answer, names the entities involved, and places dated source context close to the claim.

passages.heading: Where should source evidence appear?
passages.text: Editors should place visible source labels near factual claims, especially when the passage may be extracted independently by AI search systems.

passages.heading: Can citation readiness guarantee visibility?
passages.text: No. Citation readiness improves evidence hygiene and makes passages easier to evaluate, but it does not guarantee AI Overview, AI Mode, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, or Copilot citation.
